verdict_reason: Tests pin the new address-type helpers well, but one title claims the Type select's order while asserting only the constant.

todos.issue: Title 'Should list them in the order the Type select offers them' claims the Type select's option order, but the assertion only compares the ROLES_BY_ADDRESS_TYPE constant with a literal. Reordering or rebuilding the select's options in the list view model (fed via address-book-tabs.js:10) leaves this test green, and the add form reorders the same roles with placeRolesFirst (add.controller.js:145), so the constant's order is not what every screen offers.
todos.fix: Must: the title states only what the assertion proves - the roles each address type lists, in that order - and the Type select's order is proven by a test on the list view model or page that builds the select. One way: retitle to 'Should list each address type's roles in this order' and rely on (or add) a list view-model test that asserts the Type select's option values.
